description: Improve the UI/interface: add dark mode support, improve visual polish with subtle animations, add a search/filter capability on the home page, and enhance the project card and detail page design.
steps: Add dark mode CSS: create a @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) section in app/globals.css that redefines all CSS custom properties (--background, --surface, --text, --border, etc.) for dark theme. Keep the existing green/natural aesthetic but with dark backgrounds.

Add subtle entrance animations: create a @keyframes fadeInUp animation and apply it to .project-card, .category-card, .use-case cards with staggered delays using animation-delay. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Improve the hero section: add a subtle gradient mesh or dot grid pattern as background decoration to make it more visually interesting.
Enhance project cards: add a subtle gradient border on hover, improve spacing, add a small deploy method badge (Docker/Helm/Binary icon) at the bottom of each card.
Improve the project detail page: add breadcrumb navigation at the top, improve the meta panel styling with subtle icons or colored indicators for score ranges (green for 85+, amber for 70-84, etc.).

Add a simple client-side search/filter component at the top of the projects section on the home page that filters projects by name or tag as the user types. Create components/search-filter.tsx as a 'use client' component.
Improve the footer: add useful links (GitHub repo link, categories quick links) and a cleaner two-column layout.
Add smooth scroll-to-top button component that appears when user scrolls down.
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode activates automatically based on system preference with appropriate color scheme
Cards have subtle entrance animations that respect prefers-reduced-motion
A search input on the home page filters displayed projects in real-time
Project detail page has breadcrumb navigation
Score badges show color coding (green/amber/red) based on score value
Footer has a richer layout with navigation links
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm it succeeds
Run pnpm lint and confirm no type errors
findings: All UI improvements implemented and verified. pnpm lint (tsc --noEmit) passes. pnpm build generates 42 static pages successfully. Dark mode uses prefers-color-scheme media query. Animations use prefers-reduced-motion for accessibility. Search filter is a client component that filters by project name or tags. Score color coding uses CSS classes (score-green, score-amber, score-red). Footer uses categories imported from data/projects.ts.
